content.short: Rehide is a non-custodial password storage manager with zero-knowledge encryption.
content.description: Rehide is a non-custodial Web3 password manager that integrates with popular EVM-compatible wallets to deliver robust security. It gives users full control of passwords and confidential notes, supported by wallet-based access and a focus on data ownership. Unlike traditional managers, Rehide embraces a new, wallet-driven approach to protecting personal data, making it ideal for anyone who prioritizes safeguarding sensitive information in the digital era.
